lastResponse.text: First step: if your chest is still tight or getting worse, call nine one one now: nine… one… one. For transportation to non-emergency medical care, I have Cascades West Ride Line. Call 5 4 1… 9 2 4… 8 7 3 8. Second number: 5 4 1… 9 6 7… 8 6 3 0. They coordinate rides for eligible Oregon Health Plan Medicaid and related members.
originalTexts: First step: if your chest is still tight or getting worse, call **9-1-1** now: **nine… one… one**. For transportation to non-emergency medical care, I have **Cascades West Ride Line**. Call **5 4 1… 9 2 4… 8 7 3 8**. Second number: **5 4 1… 9 6 7… 8 6 3 0**. They coordinate rides for eligible Oregon Health Plan Medicaid and related members.
